title: StockSmart Credit Desk Note — Returned Payments and the Share Carried in a New Consigned Bin
content:
**Rule.** When a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint machines, the customer's returned payments with a transaction date in the last twelve months put a payment-record share into the carried share of that bin's fill-to level: 2 or more returned payments put 0.6, exactly 1 puts 0.8, and none puts no payment-record share in, leaving the carried share as it is.

**Record read.** Returned payments booked on the customer's Commercial Credit Account, counted by their transaction date. The last twelve months hold rows of age below twelve, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

| Returned payments dated in the last twelve months | Payment-record share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.6 |
| exactly 1 | 0.8 |
| none | none put in |

**Hypothetical boundary.** With today on 15 June, a returned payment dated 15 June of the previous year is of age twelve and falls outside the window; one dated 16 June of the previous year is of age eleven and counts.
